name: Casino Hold'em
description: Casino Hold'em Poker is a casino table game introduced in 2001 by Stephen Au-Yeung. Based on Texas Hold'em, players compete against the house (not each other). Players make an ante bet, receive two hole cards, see a three-card flop, then decide to fold or place a play bet (2x ante). Best 5-card poker hand wins.

content.text: Casino Hold'em Poker is a casino table game introduced in 2001 by Stephen Au-Yeung. Based on Texas Hold'em, players compete against the house (not each other). Players make an ante bet, receive two hole cards, see a three-card flop, then decide to fold or place a play bet (2x ante). Best 5-card poker hand wins.
Casino Hold'em Poker was introduced by Stephen Au-Yeung in 2001. It was developed to capitalize on the enormous popularity of Texas Hold'em poker by creating a house-banked casino version.
Any number of players, each playing individually against the house/dealer. No player vs player action.
Standard 52-card pack. Standard poker hand rankings apply.
Standard deck, casino chips, table with betting areas
Each player and dealer receive 2 hole cards face down. 5 community cards dealt in stages: 3-card flop (face up), turn, river.
